personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every floor area, collect all 5 coins, gems, relics, keys and hearts, open every locked door and finish the level with the timer and lives in view.
personas.style: Plans routes with goto:x,y macros, sweeps each room, then checks the HUD after every pickup. Uses the lever and gates deliberately, and finishes with Finish and Play again.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit, the victory dialog or high-value items by unintended routes: dashing over gates, walls and locked doors, stepping on spikes to test the score floor, and reaching the exit before collecting keys.
personas.style: Tries dashes into solid tiles, bumps into closed gates and locked doors without keys, uses the lever out of order, and checks whether a dialog or win state appears too early.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break timing and state by pressing pause, Escape, Enter, restart and movement together during pickups, hits, timer expiry and level completion.
personas.style: Sends multi-key ticks such as pause+left, up+down, dash+use, and clicks dialog buttons in the same tick as movement. Spams wait and inputs during transitions and checks the game never desyncs.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each sentence literally, including the tick order, the dash recharge values, the invulnerability window, and the respawn position.
personas.style: Starts from a fresh seed, performs each documented action exactly once, and reads the HUD text against the state after every tick. Reports any sentence the build contradicts.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, keys, coins and the timer to their limits: score floor at 0, cap at 999,999, 5 lives maximum, timer at 0 and reset, and time bonus arithmetic.
personas.style: Deliberately takes spikes at low score, collects hearts at 5 lives, lets the timer run out, and compares every counter with its HUD text and with the bonus after completion.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Level complete, Game over, victory) and check what is shown, what text it has, and which buttons are actually clickable.
personas.style: Pauses in each state, checks that the visible dialog matches the mode, clicks each visible button and checks that no button is covered (top must be true).

checks.rule: Score is never negative; spikes stop at 0.
Score is capped at 999,999.
The player starts with 3 lives, with a maximum of 5.
A heart never raises lives above 5; with 5 lives the heart gives 500 score instead.
The timer is between 0 and 300 and resets to 300 when it hits 0.
The timer drops by exactly 1 per running tick; at 0 a life is lost and the timer resets to 300.
While paused nothing moves: the timer, dash recharge, clock and toasts are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock && cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y

checks.rule: While paused nothing moves; enemies do not move.
A dash sets the recharge to 6 and at the end of that running tick it is 5.
The dash recharge drops by 1 per running tick and stays at 0 once ready.
The dash is ready exactly when the recharge is 0, and the recharge is always 0 to 6.
The HUD shows the current score.
The HUD shows the current lives.
The HUD shows keys and Coins n/5 from the current state.
The dash status reads Dash ready when the recharge is 0, otherwise Dash n.
Items disappear when collected and never come back (except on restart); coins, gems and relics never decrease.
checks.expect: cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.gems >= prev.state.gems && cur.state.relics >= prev.state.relics && cur.state.keys >= 0 && cur.state.coins <= 5

checks.rule: Score only drops through spikes (and restart).
Spikes always cost one life, even right after a respawn.
After losing a life you reappear at (1, 1).
Enemies cannot hurt you in the tick you reappear and the next 4 ticks; invulnerable counts 4 after respawn and stays 0 to 4.
Restart level restores score 0, 3 lives, all items, timer 300, and the game runs straight away.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: At 0 lives the game is over with the Game over dialog and a Retry button.
checks.expect: cur.state.mode == 'gameover' && any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Game over'))

checks.rule: While the game is playing no dialog is open.
Pausing opens the pause menu with Resume and Restart level; the game is never paused without it (no softlock).
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'button' && u.visible && u.id == 'btn-resume') && any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'button' && u.visible && u.id == 'btn-restart')

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.
checks.expect: count(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'button' && u.visible && u.top == false) == 0

checks.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.
Finish shows the victory dialog with Play again; the won state is reached only through Finish.
The player never stands on a wall, a closed gate or a locked door.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D' && !(tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) == '=' && !cur.state.gateOpen)

checks.rule: The map is 14 x 10; the player and enemies stay inside it.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x >= 0 && cur.state.player.x <= 13 && cur.state.player.y >= 0 && cur.state.player.y <= 9 && all(cur.state.enemies, e => e.x >= 0 && e.x <= 13 && e.y >= 0 && e.y <= 9)

checks.rule: Walls are solid and never change tile.

Timer expiry needs a long walk or a later round that continues from a known state. Plans below target low-score spikes, the 5-life heart rule, and finish/bonus arithmetic. value.notes: Economy focus. Gaps: (1) Timer 0 and reset needs 300 running ticks, and a plan is capped at 120 tokens, so it cannot be reached in one plan. Only waits or moves tick the timer, and pause freezes it. Consider a note to the lead rather than a plan. (2) Lives cap at 5 needs two hearts, but only one heart (3,8) is known in the seed 31337 and 777 maps. (3) Score cap 999,999 is unreachable in 120 tokens. Plans below probe the score floor at low score, heart pickup, and the dash-over-spikes path. Tile coordinates are from the seed 31337 map and the goto targets are unverified.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After collecting a coin (state coins=1, score 100), the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5' at tick 1 and later.
verdicts.expected: HUD always shows the current values, so after one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast
verdicts.observed: With the pause menu open, btn-resume reports top=false (not the topmost element at its centre) while the 'Key collected' toast is visible, so a click on Resume would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it.

verdicts.title: Pause-freeze check fires on Restart click (not a separate bug)
verdicts.observed: The violation comes from clicking Restart, which resets the timer, player position and enemies. That change is the intended restart effect. The real defect (game stays paused after restart) is captured by candidate 3.
verdicts.expected: Restart resets the level and the game runs straight away; the pause-freeze rule does not apply to that reset.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused with no dialog
verdicts.observed: After pause then click btn-restart, mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu is gone; the state no longer changes across subsequent waits (time stays 300, no dialog or button to act on).
verdicts.expected: Restart puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away.

verdicts.title: Spikes drive score negative and wrap it to 65136
verdicts.observed: Spikes at score 100 produce score 65136 (wraparound from -400), and a later spike hit gives score -300.
verdicts.expected: Spikes subtract 500 but the score stops at 0 and never goes negative or wraps; score stays within 0..999,999.

verdicts.title: Victory reached via Enter on Finish dialog (by design)
verdicts.observed: Mode went complete -> won after 'enter+down'. Enter activates the dialog's main button (Finish), which is the designed path; the check only looked for a btn-next click token.
verdicts.expected: Enter activates the main button (Finish) and shows the victory dialog, so this is correct behaviour.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stale after collecting a coin during a dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-right at tick 1 the state reports coins=1 and Score 100, but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'. The score field updated in the same tick, so only the coins readout lags.
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current values, so after collecting a coin it should read 'Coins 1/5' to match state.coins.

verdicts.title: Time-bonus banner covers the Finish button on the Level complete dialog
verdicts.observed: At tick 41 the level-complete dialog is visible with btn-next (Finish) reported top=false, meaning the 'Time bonus +2590' banner sits on top of it at its centre, so a click on Finish would not reach the button.
verdicts.expected: Section 7: every visible button must be clickable and nothing may cover it. Finish should receive clicks on the Level complete dialog.
